name: Lietuvių kalba
description: Lithuanian from the alphabet to near-native command, in the manner of a classical grammar: numbered rules that explain why a form is used, illustrated by glossed examples, then drilled.
attribution: Grammar written after the manner of Ivy Kellerman Reed, A Complete Grammar of Esperanto (1910): continuously numbered rules that give the reason for a usage, followed by glossed examples. The Lithuanian itself is original to this course.
